definitions.explanation: Deep mental suffering and distress, especially when troubled by difficult problems, moral dilemmas, or situations with no clear solution. Implies prolonged inner turmoil.

examples.japanese: {懊悩|おうのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懊悩|おうのう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was agonizing over the choice.

examples.japanese: {懊悩|おうのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}した→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: After much anguish, I made my decision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懊悩|おうのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れている→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: The anguish of being a writer is reflected in the work.

notes:
{懊悩|おうのう} describes deep, prolonged mental suffering - more literary and intense than simple worry or concern.

Usage:
- {懊悩|おうのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to agonize, be in anguish)
- {懊悩|おうのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ (after much anguish)
- {懊悩|おうのう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苛|さいな}まれる→苛む：28648_sainamu⟧ (to be tormented by anguish)

Characteristics:
- Literary/formal word
- Implies prolonged suffering, not momentary distress
- Often used in serious contexts (moral dilemmas, life decisions, creative struggles)

Related words:
- ⟦{苦悩|くのう}→苦悩：05517_kunou⟧: suffering, distress (more common)
- {煩悶|はんもん}: anguish, agony (similar)
- {悶々|もんもん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be troubled, tormented
